name: Octree Volume Compression
aliases: Lossless Octree Compression via Variance Consolidation
definition: Lossless compression of octree volumes by consolidating voxels with zero variance, potentially augmented by clamping scalars outside a specific isovalue range.
summary: Octree Volume Compression reduces memory by converting structured data into an octree that consolidates uniform regions, differing from sibling methods by focusing on initial construction-phase compression.
